title: Fixture reference restoration
passage:
Document 1 | Press cell checklist: restoring a fixture after bed replacement
The reference pin locates the fixture against the bed. Start by checking whether the pin sits flush. A pin that protrudes can scratch the fixture. Stop and ask Maintenance to seat it; operators must not force the fixture down.
Once the pin is flush, run the flat reference plate before testing any production part. Mark the plate's offset as either left or right, not merely as a number. A reading of up to 0.2 millimetres in either direction passes the reference-plate check. If the magnitude exceeds 0.2 millimetres, don't adjust the fixture; have Maintenance inspect the bed. Log a skipped check as not run, never as zero.
Document 2 | Recovery log, cell 4, Thursday
08:35 / Ana / Pin standing proud; no plate check.
08:50 / Maintenance / Seated the pin. Ana ran the plate: 0.3 mm left. No production part tested.
09:20 / Maintenance / Removed a metal shaving beneath the bed. Did not move the fixture.
09:40 / Ana / Plate returned 0.2 mm right. Sent the result to Calder.
09:55 / Calder / Reply entered in the recovery log: Please write both the failed run and the repeat result into the shift report. Use the repeat result as the comparison baseline for tomorrow. Keep the first reading in the report but do not average them: the first was taken before Maintenance removed the metal shaving.

文件一｜沖壓工作區檢查表：更換機床台面後的治具復歸
定位銷用來讓治具靠機床台面定位。先檢查銷是否與台面齊平。凸出的定位銷可能刮傷治具。請停下並請維修人員將銷裝到位；操作員不得硬把治具壓下。
定位銷齊平後，先用平面基準板試測，再測試生產件。紀錄基準板偏移量時請註明向左或向右，不可只記數值。不論方向，偏移量只要不超過 0.2 毫米，就通過基準板檢查。若偏移量超過 0.2 毫米，不要調治具，請維修人員檢查機床台面。未做的檢查應記「未執行」，不得記為零。
文件二｜第四工作區恢復紀錄，週四
08:35／Ana／定位銷凸出；未做基準板檢查。
08:50／維修／將定位銷裝到位。Ana 試測基準板：向左 0.3 毫米。未測生產件。
09:20／維修／清除台面下方一片金屬屑。未移動治具。
09:40／Ana／基準板結果為向右 0.2 毫米。已將結果傳給 Calder。
09:55／Calder／錄入復歸紀錄的回覆：請在交班報告記下未通過的那次測試與複測結果。請以複測結果作為明天的比對基準。保留首筆讀值，但不要取平均；第一次量測時，維修人員還沒移除金屬屑。
